reviews.text: He smells great all week long!
She's an excellent groomer and trims my dog's nails like no one else!
My son was treated very well, with respect for his pace and limits. I highly recommend Carol.

My kitten has long fur and dermatitis, so the vet recommended a bath with special shampoo and a hygienic trim. I was worried about finding an establishment accustomed to cats, since kittens are more anxious and stressed when their routine is disrupted, until I found super positive reviews here from cat owners. I decided to trust them and everything was incredible. Aunt Carol took great care of Alfred; she's experienced, careful, patient, and also a cat lover, so she understands our kittens' behavior very well. I recommend them!
